camel_example: aliyun dts DescribeTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --Category Custom --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --PageNumber 1 --ResourceId dtsl5o11f9029c0000 --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key owner
description_en: Queries all values of a tag key that is attached to a data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeTagValues接口查找一个迁移、同步或订阅实例绑定的标签键对应的所有值
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-tag-values --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --resource-type ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE --resource-id dtsl5o11f9029c0000 --category Custom --key owner --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTagValues

parameters.help_en: The number of tag values to return per page when a tag key has multiple tag values. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 当一个标签键对应多个标签值时，选择一次返回标签值的个数，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Specifies the page to return when a tag key has multiple tag values. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. This parameter is typically used together with PageSize. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，当一个标签键对应多个标签值时，选择返回的起始页。取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，通常与PageSize搭配使用，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource type defined by the system. Set the value to ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 系统服务规定参数，固定取值为：ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the instance ID.

If this parameter is left empty, all tag values of the specified tag key for the current account are returned
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移、同步或订阅的实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询。

取值为空时，返回该用户下对应标签键的所有标签值
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the tag key. Valid values:
Custom: a user-added tag key.
System: a system-created tag key.

If this parameter is left empty, all tag keys are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
标签键类型，取值：
Custom：用户添加的标签键。
System：系统创建的标签键。

当值为空时，默认返回所有的标签键
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The key of the tag.
This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
标签的键值。
本参数为必填参数
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

Category.description_en: The type of the tag key

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned tag values

PageSize.description_en: The number of tag values returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页返回标签值的数量

items.description_en: The tag values that correspond to the tag key

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tag values that correspond to the tag key
TotalCount.description_zh: 标签键对应标签值的总数
